title: Green Hollow Hymn
style: Celtic flavored new age, 96 BPM, tin whistle and Celtic harp-like melodies, soft frame drum, lush layered airy female vocals, misty highland atmosphere, gentle electronic pulse, ethereal and pastoral
negativeTags: rock, metal, country, pop punk, aggressive, rap, chiptune, EDM drop
lyrics:
[Verse]
Mist upon the hollow, dew upon the stone
Ancient roads are calling every wanderer home
Silver in the river, songs upon the breeze
Whispered by the oak and the willow trees

[Chorus]
Sing, green hollow, sing to me
Carry my heart across the sea
Sing, green hollow, soft and slow
Back to the land where the old winds blow

[Bridge]
Ah-la-ree, ah-la-ro
Where the old winds blow
